_doc: Map 2 (Totenhafen) settings not in the generic tables (MAPS.md Map 2, DECISIONS T-036). power: the Pumpenschalter in the pump room (PowerSwitch config_table map02). tide: the Pen Hall water (gravelight/maps/map02_totenhafen/tide_controller.gd): high tide on every round divisible by every_rounds from min_round, rising over rise_seconds at that round's start and falling over fall_seconds at the next round's start, between low_y and high_y; anyone inside a flood box and below the surface + 0.4 wades (players: the enemies.json status player_status, refreshed every tick; zombies: the frost slow zombie_slow); the named spawns switch while flooded; the Operator reads the forecast the round before (vo_warn), then vo_rising / vo_falling. zones/doors/roster: the zone graph the generator builds (tests/unit/test_map02_data.gd checks it against map02.tscn, enemies.json and weapons.json). ballast: the carry mechanic's data, deferred (the coffins are dressing in this pass). UPDATE 07: the exfil block leads on to Map 4 (Werk Thalbach) at round 40 from the pen hall apron.

tide.banner_warn: SHIPPING FORECAST: high water next round
tide._doc_v2: Tide v2 (UPDATE 10 section 2, contract C2, DECISIONS T-153). stage_for_round: spring on every spring_every_rounds-th round (from min_round), high on every every_rounds-th, half on the round before a high one, else low. The water rises to the stage's y over rise_seconds, holds hold_seconds[stage] (the Pumpenschalter crank takes shortens_by_s off what is left), then falls; a new round re-plans. A spring tide also raises the sheets over spring_flood_boxes (the north apron and the east apron's basin edge; the piers stay dry islands) to spring_sheet_y. wade_min_y: below it nobody wades (the half tide only fills the basins). float_drift: one drift direction per flood box (flood_boxes then spring_flood_boxes): a dropped power-up in a wet box drifts at drift_mps and is lost when it leaves the box. cables: live while their spot is wet and the power is on: zombies in radius_m are stunned stun_s, players take player_dps. storm: per-stage values the living world reads (TideController.storm_for). GLBus: tide_stage, tide_flood_begin, tide_flood_end, spring_tide; GameState flag flooded while any box is wet.

ballast._doc: The Ballast carry mechanic (T-036 follow-up): BallastCoffin interactables at coffin_spots can be lifted (lift_seconds) and carried (carry_status from enemies.json, carry_offset in the carrier's frame) to the BallastHook at crane_hook (hook_seconds); once `needed` coffins hang there the flag `flag` is set and the Pumpenschalter (PowerSwitch.requires_flag) will take the throw. A carrier who goes down drops the coffin back onto its pallet.
ballast._doc_v2: Ballast v2 (C2, T-153): a carrier's WeaponHolder is limited to melee and the pistol slot (set_carry_limit). Two destinations: the crane hook (ballast_loaded counter, Operator OPR_BALLAST_LOAD_*, +economy.json ballast_load_bonus Scrip to the carrier) and the dump at the quay parapet by the sea stairs (BallastDump at dump; the landing stages themselves are outside the barricade windows, so the dump is on the quay side; ballast_dumped counter, Operator OPR_BALLAST_DUMP_*, the next round +1 glasshide via RoundManager.extra_spawn). A delivered coffin respawns on a free pallet from coffin_spots + pallet_spots (the extra pallets beside the crane: no baked coffin stands on them) after respawn_seconds, so both choices stay open. shard_after_dumps: the Undertow's shard appears on the sea stairs after that many dumps.

searchlight._doc: The signal-tower searchlight (C2, T-153; gravelight/world/map02/searchlight.gd): a manned station that needs power. The operator is locked in (weapons holstered, Leave = interact again or jump); the beam (a SpotLight3D + a cone) slows zombies by slow (frost) and marks them +lit_damage_mult damage taken while they stand in it; bots man it via the MAN_SEARCHLIGHT mark order. During the sail it tracks the boat by itself.

crane_drop._doc: The Crane Drop trap (C2, T-153; traps.json crane_drop; gravelight/world/trap_crane.gd): a lever in the crane office swings the loading crane over the east apron and drops a pallet of crates: the kill box is box_size centred at drop (6 x 4 m), dust and a crash; the debris lies debris_seconds. cooldown from traps.json.

kielholer._doc: The Kielholer (the drowned; C2, T-153): while the GameState flag flooded is on, the surface points (pier edges, named Surface_*, emerge style water) are live and a share of the spawns are tagged kielholer / kielholer_diver (enemies.json). They grab a player within grab_range and pull toward the nearest water edge; break free by melee, 60 damage to arm_grab, or teammates.

undertow._doc: THE UNDERTOW's parts and bench (C4, T-153): two spots each for undertow_pump (lower pens) and undertow_head (the workshop tool wall / the warhead cage), seeded by the quest's ut_parts; undertow_shard only from the dump (ballast.shard_spot after ballast.shard_after_dumps dumps). The bench is in the crane office.

letzte_fahrt._doc: Letzte Fahrt's world objects (C3, design section 2, T-153). radios: the three code-group radios (cannery office, workshop bench, U-1047's radio room). cipher: the SCHLUESSELGERAET HAFEN rotor machine in the signal tower. log_spots: two seeded spots per page. diesels: the three holdouts. key_slot: the ignition in the tower's chart room. curtain_lever: on pier 2's end. boat: the sail (sail_seconds; board_points; the deck box the holdout counts as on board). boss_docks: where DER KIELHOLER surfaces. T-153 fix: the cipher machine stands mid-room facing the north windows (it stood across window W_G_N1).

inj_sequence._tuning: T-153: the engine room is a 5 m wide hull: x1.5 spawns and no ring spawns (boarders come up the gangway and from aft, the hull_pull bursts); with the default x2 and two ring points the bots alone were wiped there in four of six runs.

sherman_event._doc: T-271 Totenhafen's round-30 set piece: THE RAID ONLY (ShermanEvent with "tank": false; AirRaid). No tank on a harbour quay (T-273: the dive bomber came later, see _doc_t273): on round 30 the siren, a countdown, then sixty seconds of bombs on the open quay and the roofless part of the cannery (bomb_zones); the pens are what they were built for (shelter_zones: the workshop, the pen hall, the boat, the lower pens, the signal tower), and any roof shelters (shelter_roof: the quay's hut, the cannery's roofed half). Round 30, not 40: round 40 is the campaign's exfil here. shelter_points: where a bot outside runs to (inside both pen hall doors, the cannery's roofed corner). raid: this map's banners over sherman.json's.
sherman_event._doc_t273: T-273 (the map detail pass): the raid opens with a dive bomber after all. Its landmark is the patrol boat V 1507 moored 20 m off the parapet (gen_map02 PATROL_BOAT, DetailMap02.patrol_boat): stuka_target is its wheelhouse, from the north over the sea (stuka_from), so the quay sees the dive; the bomb is 20 m from the nearest player's ground (it hurts within 6.5 m). stuka_hit_show: the boat's fire (hidden until the bomb lands; ShermanEvent.show_hit_nodes). raid.vo_warn / vo_clear: the Operator's own lines for the pens (Map 0's sent you to the cellars); vo_during was already this map's. raid.burst: a bomb on the concrete quay throws stone and a little snow (AirRaid.burst_fx; Map 0 keeps snow and earth).
